dedupe_keys.name: ukho admiralty marine data portal bathymetry maritime limits and ships routeing

description: The ADMIRALTY Marine Data Portal of the UK Hydrographic Office gives access to marine datasets held by the UKHO, replacing its earlier INSPIRE portal. It offers more than 4,000 bathymetry surfaces within the UK Exclusive Economic Zone, maritime limits and boundaries for the UK, Crown Dependencies and Overseas Territories, ships' routeing measures around the UK approved by the International Maritime Organization or the Maritime and Coastguard Agency, a worldwide dataset of over 94,000 wrecks and obstructions updated quarterly, and offshore infrastructure data such as wind farms, structures, pipelines and safety zones. Coverage is the UK EEZ for most layers, with worldwide wrecks. Access: the data.gov.uk entry lists the portal under the Open Government Licence, and the wrecks dataset is free under the Open Government Licence; offshore infrastructure data can be previewed, purchased and downloaded. Caveats: licences and cost differ by dataset, and the portal is an interactive web application. It supports port approach and shipping lane modelling, hazard exposure of navigation routes and maritime network models, and complements the UK MMO AIS track lines and the UK port data catalogued here.
